LaptopDreamOpen.dc.html.title: Laptop · Log · Dreams — a dream opened

ln1.text: Laptop = simpler, mouse + keyboard. Left rail (same 5 hubs, same order), content uses the width: two columns. No swipe on a laptop, so task rows show Done / Delete buttons on hover. Dates as MM-dd-yyyy (Phase 14 rule). '+ New' top right opens the same log picker; N is the keyboard shortcut. Same Forest green colours. Text is placeholder.

ln2.text: Log: chips across the top (room for all six). List on the left; the form opens in the right panel instead of a sheet, so you can see the list while adding. Esc cancels, Enter saves. Other chips follow the same split. All Log chips: list or cards on the left, the add form docked on the right (Check-ins 1–5 buttons starting at 3, Meals with typeable MM-dd-yyyy date + time, Tasks with due chips). Journal writes in the right pane; Dreams opens the selected dream on the right. Clicking a dream opens it in the right pane: full text, mood, lucid, tags, Edit/Delete, and the green Interpretation card with Interpret again (or an Interpret button if there's none yet).

ln3.text: Chat: chat list always visible on the left (10 max, Weekly report pinned, Memory link), conversation on the right. Enter sends, Shift+Enter new line. Same Undo, pick chips and yes/no cards as the phone. A hide-chats icon (top of the list, Ctrl+B) collapses the list so the conversation gets the full width; the same icon at the top left of the conversation brings it back.

ln4.text: Insights: chips across the top; charts in a 2-column grid so you see more at once. Screentime keeps All | Laptop | Phone and This day | 7 days. Health adds back the day-by-day list (there's room). Screentime shows Label apps in a side panel (Phone | Laptop). Goals opens the selected goal's steps on the right; '+ New goal' top right.

ln5.text: Browse: chips across the top. Files: folders on the left, docs in the middle, the open doc on the right. Laptop-only settings (start with Windows, tray, XPS Ollama URL) live in Browse > Settings here. Study: course cards + All exams panel. Mail: list + reading pane with Draft reply. Hardware: form + past checks + opened explanation. Settings: 4 cards including 'Laptop only'.

n1.text: Chosen: Forest green. Layout: date + sync on top (pull down to resync), briefing card, tasks with swipe only (right = done, left = delete), exam tiles, + opens a picker for every log type. Text is placeholder.

n10.text: Same shell: chips above the bar (Files, Study, Mail, Hardware, Settings; the row scrolls). Each keeps today's features, redrawn as cards. Files: search, folders as chips, docs list, + New doc. Study: courses as cards with exam countdown, study set / quiz / summary buttons. Mail: unread, Wally's inbox suggestions with Approve/Reject, drafts. Hardware: describe a problem, past checks. Settings: grouped cards (Sync, Connections, Laptop only). Text is placeholder. All exams (from 'All exams' on Study): upcoming with countdown, past, + Exam; tap = edit, swipe left = delete.

n2.text: Chosen: chips above the bar, today + yesterday as cards, 'See all check-ins' under them. + adds a check-in only (sheet: scores start at 3, tap to change, optional note, date defaults to today). History: all-green 5-dot meters, month button at the top. Values are placeholders.

n3.text: Chosen: this week split by category, then today's rows, 'See all spending'. + adds spending only (sheet: amount, category tiles, optional note, date defaults to today). Rows: tap = edit, swipe left = delete. Amounts are placeholders.

n4.text: Same pattern. Main: today's and yesterday's entries as cards (time + first 3 lines), 'See all entries', + to write. History: days newest first, month button. Write: full screen, big text area, Save at the bottom. NEW: an unsaved draft is kept if you close the screen (chosen). Entries store only text + the time written. Text is placeholder.

n5.text: Same pattern. Main: today's estimated total (kcal + protein/carbs/fat), today's meals and snacks, 'See all meals' (yesterday lives in history, since a day of meals fills the screen). Each row: time, Meal/Snack tag, what you ate, nutrition line. States: estimate done, estimating, failed. Chosen: 'Look up' (asks Codex) shows on failed rows and inside every meal's edit screen, not on every row. Add sheet: Cancel + Save row at the bottom (same as Spending), Meal | Snack, what you ate, date + time pickers; nutrition is estimated after saving. Numbers are placeholders.

n6.text: Same pattern. Main: open tasks grouped by due date (Overdue, Today, This week, Later, No date); swipe right = done, swipe left = delete, tap = edit (same as Today). 'See completed tasks' opens history (done tasks by the day finished, month button). Add sheet: title, due-date quick chips (None by default, Today, Tomorrow, Pick date), Cancel + Save. Chosen: no goal option on Tasks screens; goal tasks are managed from the Goals screen. Titles are placeholders.

n7.text: Same pattern. Main: recent dreams (date, mood dots, lucid tag, tags, 2 lines, 'Interpreted' mark), 'See all dreams', +. History: month counts (dreams, lucid), dreams by week. Chosen: pattern summaries removed from the app (no Patterns card, no 'Find patterns'). Write: full screen like Journal (text, mood on waking 1–5, lucid circle checkbox, tags, draft kept). Opened dream: full text, details, interpretation with 'Interpret again', Edit button. Text is placeholder. Approved changes: draft kept, new dream defaults to last night, opening a dream shows it to read first (Edit is separate).

n8.text: Bottom bar order changed on every screen: Today · Log · Chat · Insights · Browse (Chat in the middle). Chat follows the Phase 15 plan: small adds happen at once with a 30-s Undo; bigger changes show a yes/no card; several matches show pick chips; up to 10 chats on both devices, the Weekly report pinned; starting an 11th summarizes the oldest into Browse > Memory. Composer sits right above the bar. Messages are placeholders. Chosen: offline banner plus a send queue (unsent messages wait with a clock icon and send when back online) — check whether Phase 15 already plans the queue. Bar order change must be applied to the Phase 14 plan. Chosen: Memory opens from the chat list (Chat hub) instead of Browse > Memory.

n9.text: Same shell as Log: chips above the bar (Charts, Health, Screentime, Goals), no + except 'New goal' on Goals. Each chip keeps today's content, redrawn as cards with green charts. Charts: check-in lines, spending by category, per month, tasks per week. Health: last-night tiles, sleep and steps charts, workouts. Screentime: This day / 7 days, unlabelled-apps banner, minutes per label (Productive, Unproductive, Neutral, Not labelled), top apps, Spotify; label screen holds labelling, suggestions and rules. Goals: goal cards with step progress, Dream week card. Numbers are placeholders.
